source_units.text: I am using a model railway to understand why trains are kept apart.
Turn my signalling reading into a study schedule.
The syllabus consists of "Block Sections", "Interlocking", "Signal Aspects"; each named topic needs a minimum of 15 minutes in total.
I have no preferred topic order and no additional minimum-time requirements.
The total of all sessions on any one date must not exceed 35 minutes.
